about.title: About EasyPark
about.content: EasyPark is a real-time parking management platform that connects drivers with available spaces and gives parking operators digital control of their facilities.

home.title: Welcome
home.content: Welcome to EasyPark. Less driving around looking for a space, more control when managing one.
